title: configure-env schema v1
description: The env files a project needs and the variables they hold, for configure-env.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema URL, for editors.

group.description: A heading that groups related variables.

required.description: Whether the variable must be set.

secret.description: Mask the value in output and never echo it in errors.

allowEmpty.description: Whether an empty value is accepted. Defaults to true when the variable is not required.

comment.description: Text written as `#` comment lines above the key in generated files; may span lines.

requiredUnless.description: The variable is required unless one of these is set (non-empty). Not with `required: true`.

conflictsWith.description: The variable and one of these must not both be set (non-empty).

distinctFrom.description: When the variable and one of these are both set, their values must differ.

protected.description: Once a file holds a value, never replace or remove it without --replace-protected. Needs `secret: true`; no effect on templates.

reason.description: Why the value must never change, shown in errors.

default.description: The value used when none is given.

example.description: A sample value shown to people.

patternMessage.description: The error shown when the value does not match `pattern`.

encoding.description: The value must be bytes in this encoding: base64 with padding, base64url without padding, or hex of either case.

bytes.description: The number of bytes the value must decode to; needs `encoding`.

path.description: Relative to the project root, with forward slashes; no `..` or absolute paths.

policy.description: generate: rewrite the whole file; merge: append missing keys and keep the rest; create-only: write it only when it does not exist.

variables.description: "*" for every variable in declaration order, or the variable names in output order.

header.description: Text written as `#` comment lines at the top of the file; may span lines.

template.description: Whether the file is a template, committed with placeholders: it takes only `values` and defaults, never values a person or the environment gives. Defaults to true when the path ends in .example, .sample or .template.

values.description: Literal values for this file that replace the defaults, like placeholders in an example file. Written after `KEY=` as is; not type-checked.

comments.description: Comments for this file that replace the variables' own `comment`; may span lines.
